root_causes.root_cause: RFC-035 D2 landscape rasterize-rotate-reextract path appends OCR-fragmented markdown (chart axis labels/values from 300 DPI rasterized pages) that _segment_table_nodes shatters into 71+ singleton kv blocks. The _repair_docling_tables changes (RFC-035 D0 prev_was_separator guard + RFC-034 D17 bilingual guard) also prevent previously-collapsed degenerate chart-data rows from being collapsed, so they survive as individual rows and each becomes a separate block. Additionally, landscape_fallback_picture PictureResults with skipped_reason trigger image_enrichment_promoted verdict without actual enrichment content.
root_causes.code_path: converters.py::_landscape_rasterize_rotate_reextract -> pdf_to_markdown_docling (md append at line ~3250) -> _repair_docling_tables (D0/D17 guards) -> helpers.py::_segment_table_nodes -> classify_verdict (image_enrichment_promoted)
root_causes.suggested_fix: 1) Do not blindly append landscape fallback markdown; instead splice it into the correct page position in the document. 2) Add a chart-content-aware guard to _segment_table_nodes that skips segmentation when table rows are predominantly single-value axis labels (high singleton ratio). 3) Do not emit landscape_fallback_picture PictureResults with skipped_reason as they trigger false image_enrichment_promoted verdicts without actual enrichment.

root_causes.root_cause: extract_nodes_from_markdown in the pageindex library (page_index_md.py:32-59) only detects #-prefixed markdown headings via regex r'^(#{1,6})\s+(.+)$'. Docling's markdown export for legal documents produces either all headings at the same level (all ## -> depth 2) or no # headings at all for Arabic documents (Arabic structural patterns like Article/Chapter/Section are emitted as body text, not # headings). build_tree_from_nodes then creates a flat/shallow tree. split_oversized_leaf_nodes provides partial mitigation for ordinal-pattern tail blobs but cannot synthesize deeper hierarchy from article/chapter patterns in body text. This is a persistent architectural limitation, not a recent regression.
root_causes.code_path: pageindex.page_index_md::extract_nodes_from_markdown (heading regex) -> build_tree_from_nodes (level-based stack) -> client.py::_run_md_to_tree -> index() -> split_oversized_leaf_nodes (partial mitigation only)
root_causes.suggested_fix: Add a post-tree-build hierarchy synthesis pass that detects legal document patterns (Article N, Chapter N, Section N, and Arabic equivalents) in node body text and promotes them to child nodes at appropriate depth levels. Alternatively, enhance split_oversized_leaf_nodes to recognize multi-level legal numbering (Book > Chapter > Section > Article) and create nested children rather than flat siblings.
